Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in identifying a hidden quasi-chelation effect in ether-based nitrile solvents that undermines weakly solvating electrolyte design, and overcoming it via thioether substitution (replacing oxygen with sulfur). This breaks quasi-chelation, weakens Li⁺-solvent interactions, lowers desolvation barriers, and forms sulfur-rich inorganic interphases, enabling stable Li anode and SPAN cathode with 86% capacity retention over 600 cycles.

item.title: Unlocking Cooperative Interfacial Orbital Coupling via Phosphorus‐Induced Bond Reconstruction in MoSe 2 /MXene for Accelerated Sulfur Redox Kinetics
item.description:
دوپینگ فسفر در MoSe2/MXene با بازسازی پیوند و جفت‌شدگی اوربیتالی، سینتیک تبدیل پلی‌سولفید را تسریع کرده و باتری Li-S با ظرفیت 537 mAh g−1 در 4C ارائه می‌دهد.
Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 P-doping induces local strain in MoSe₂/MXene, reconstructing Mo-Se bonds to create undercoordinated Mo sites and Se vacancies. This shifts Mo-d/Se-p band centers upward, enhancing cooperative Mo-S and Li-Se orbital coupling at the polysulfide interface. The result is accelerated sulfur redox kinetics, lower Li₂S barriers, and Li-S cells with 537 mAh g⁻¹ at 4C and stable high-loading performance.
🏷 lithium-sulfur battery · MoSe2/MXene · phosphorus doping · orbital coupling · polysulfide conversion

item.title: Thermally Engineered Defects and Surface Architecture for High‐Performance Reversible Solid Oxide Cells Air Electrode
item.description:

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Thermal processing alone—lowering calcination from 1000 to 800°C—coordinately tunes defect chemistry and surface architecture of LSCF, activating Co/Fe redox centers, enriching oxygen vacancies, and suppressing Sr segregation without complex compositional modification. This scalable strategy yields exceptional performance (0.014 Ω cm², 0.057% h⁻¹ degradation at 700°C), establishing thermal regulation as a simple route to high-performance reversible solid oxide cell air electrodes.

💡 The novelty lies in revealing how mechanochemical behaviors expose a metastable Li1−xFePO4 region, driving competitive phase transformation into Fe3(PO4)2 coated with dense Fe2O3, causing uneven carbon and lattice stress. 💡 The novelty lies in using molecular polarization to homogenize interfacial electrostatic fields, a previously unexplored strategy beyond mechanical or chemical regulation.
